definitions.explanation: An onomatopoeic word for the chirping sound of sparrows or similar small birds. Often evokes a peaceful morning scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雀|すずめ}→雀：05006_suzume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧チュンチュン⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{鳴|な}いている→鳴く：04388_naku⟧。

examples.english: I woke up in the morning to the sound of birds chirping.

examples.japanese: ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}っている→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{雀|すずめ}→雀：05006_suzume⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧チュンチュン⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦にぎやか→にぎやか：00873_nigiyaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鳴|な}き→鳴く：04388_naku⟧⟦{交|か}わしていた→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧。
examples.english: As I sat on the veranda, the sparrows gathered in the garden were cheerfully chattering away.

notes:
The standard onomatopoeia for sparrow chirping in Japanese. Associated with peaceful everyday scenes, especially mornings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ before a verb, or as a standalone sound effect:
- チュンチュン⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{鳴|な}く→鳴く：04388_naku⟧: to chirp
- チュンチュン⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: the chirping sound
